memory: I found 28 initial latency outliers in 1000 pushes (2.8%); 10 persisted at +12 ms, 8 at +24 ms. This contradicts the independence/memoryless assumption: many spikes die within 12 ms, a minority persist and then remain persistent. Standing plan: map survival S(t) at 3–48 ms with dense rechecks (N≈100 spike-traces), then run paired policy tests comparing Δ1=6 ms and Δ1=12 ms (Δ2=24 ms) under median ±3·MAD deadband.
